# Parse the verified data and build a formatted text file
lines = verify_data.split('\n')
text_lines = []
text_lines.append("=" * 90)
text_lines.append("CONFIRMED ORDERS REPORT")
text_lines.append("Source: order_summary.xlsx | Total Confirmed: 24 out of 27 orders")
text_lines.append("=" * 90)
text_lines.append("")
text_lines.append(f"{'Order ID':<14} {'Customer':<22} {'Date':<14} {'Total Paid':>10}  Items")
text_lines.append("-" * 90)

# Parse each data row from the verified output
import re
row_pattern = re.compile(r'\((\d+), 1\): (.+?)\t\(\d+, 2\): (.+?)\t\(\d+, 3\): (.+?)\t\(\d+, 4\): (.+?)\t\(\d+, 5\): (.+?)\t\(\d+, 6\): (.+?)\t')

order_count = 0
total_revenue = 0
for line in lines:
    m = row_pattern.search(line)
    if m:
        row_num = int(m.group(1))
        if row_num == 1:
            continue  # skip header
        order_id = m.group(2).strip()
        customer = m.group(3).strip()
        date = m.group(4).strip()
        status = m.group(5).strip()
        items = m.group(6).strip()
        total_paid = m.group(7).strip()
        try:
            total_val = int(float(total_paid))
        except ValueError:
            total_val = 0
        total_revenue += total_val
        order_count += 1
        text_lines.append(f"{order_id:<14} {customer:<22} {date:<14} ${total_val:>9}  {items}")

text_lines.append("-" * 90)
text_lines.append(f"{'TOTAL':<14} {'':<22} {'':<14} ${total_revenue:>9}  ({order_count} orders)")
text_lines.append("=" * 90)

text_content = '\n'.join(text_lines)
print(text_content)
